Mia (PM): Quick sync — planning rollout for model-routing v1. Proposal: tiny regional canary + 5% global A/B behind a feature flag. Auto-fallback to baseline model if latency > 300ms or error rate > 1% for 5m. Any immediate concerns?
Sam (Eng): SGTM. Couple notes: use two flags so we can control canary vs global separately. Example names: 
```
feature.model_routing.v1 = on/off
feature.model_routing.v1_canary = on/off
```
Also prefer per-tenant opt-in for first week.
Jordan (SRE): Add escalation thresholds: if 5xx rate spikes > 0.5% sustained over 3m -> auto-disable canary. Also require request tracing with route_id + model_variant in logs. Need alert for p99 latency crossing 500ms for 2m.
Eva (Product Ops): Telemetry checklist: p50/p95/p99 histograms, per-tenant error rate, token-cost delta vs baseline, and sample prompts for quality checks. Can Analytics own the A/B metric deck? @analytics-team
Mia (PM): Yes, Analytics + QA will own metrics and quality gating. For launch criteria: 72h stable canary, error delta <= 0.2pp vs baseline, latency p95 within 10% of baseline, and no regression in the acceptance prompt set.
Sam (Eng): Rollout plan I'll draft:
- Phase 0: internal shadow for 24h
- Phase 1: regional canary (us-west, eu-west), 1% traffic, 12h bake
- Phase 2: 5% global A/B, 72h bake + metrics check
- Phase 3: ramp to 25% then full.
I'll include config snippet and circuit-break config in the PR.
Jordan (SRE): Suggest automated fallback policy code: if any of these hit, flip feature.model_routing.v1_canary -> off and set route to baseline for affected region/tenants. Also add a manual kill-switch owned by oncall.
Eva (Product Ops): Need negotiation on scope: some enterprise tenant customers asked to opt-out — we should add a tenant-exemption list in the rollout config. Also document communication plan for customers in the first 48h.
Mia (PM): Good call. Sam, can you include tenant-exempt list and a small runbook for CS in the PR?
Sam (Eng): Yep — will include runbook + sample Slack templates. Targeting PR by EOD. :thumbsup:
DeployBot: deploy-bot: Canary deployment window available 2026-03-25T21:00Z, requires approvals from @Mia (PM) and @Jordan (SRE).
